none: PAS FindID 1029524: Roman coin: commemorative radiate for Claudius II
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Radiate commemorating Claudius II (268-270), probably issued under Quintillus (270), Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust right. Obverse inscription: CLA[--]. Reverse description: Eagle standing. Reverse inscription: [CONSE]CRATIO. Diameter: 15.0mm, Weight: 1.45gms, die axis: 12
